tendencies.text: Rank candidates who have led rounds (role lead, high lead_share) above those who only joined rounds; a candidate seen only as a participant goes in rejected with reason follower_only when lead history is known.
Reject only on an observed fact: stage, sector, country or check size that clearly does not fit the subject. A missing or unknown field never rejects; rank it lower and say confidence low.
Prefer candidates with a lead in the 24 months before request.as_of; mark older activity as inactive. Ignore anything dated after request.as_of.
Every reason cites at least one evidence id from the evidence list; add each profile fact or web page you rely on to evidence once, with its ref or url.
Use only candidate ids from the input, each at most once across matches and rejected; never add the subject or new names.

Before scoring, drop every fact dated after request.as_of. Examples: Lightspeed's 'Mistral AI, Jun 2023' when as_of is 2023-05-31, and redalpine's 'Led Proxima Fusion, Jun 2025' when as_of is 2025-05-31. Don't let those facts set last_lead_date, role or rank. Add a warning naming each fact you excluded.

Give the most weight to the role an investor actually played. A 'Led X' fact dated on or before as_of gets role=lead and a high score. A plain 'Invested in X' fact only shows participation (role=participant, lower score). Only use the follower_only rejection when the evidence shows the investor repeatedly followed and never led.

Score each candidate with separate score_parts: lead_history, recency, stage, sector, geography and check size. Recent leads at the subject's stage (within about 12-18 months of as_of) score highest. Sector fit should come from the investor's latest deals, not from its name alone.

Compare the raise to what the investor can realistically lead. A lead usually writes 50-70% of the round, so a $100M+ raise needs a large multi-stage or growth fund. Reject accelerators, micro-funds and grant bodies on size_mismatch or stage_mismatch only when that is clear. Reject an obvious single-sector fund on sector_mismatch, e.g. a defence or energy fund for a biotech subject.

If a candidate has no facts dated on or before as_of, don't invent activity or reasons. Either leave it out or give it a low score with role=unknown, active.status='unknown' and confidence=low. Every reason must cite a real evidence id from the dataset or from a web page you read with its url. Return at most top_k matches.

notes: Drafted by the training research step from web search. Not validated.
